question: If the median of a data is 46.36 less than its mode, then the median of the data exceeds its mean by______. (Use the empirical formula)
solution:
**Given:**

Median = Mode - 46.36

Empirical formula: Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

**Formula used:**

Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

**Calculations:**

Mode = Median + 46.36

⇒ Median + 46.36 = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

⇒ 46.36 = 3(Median) - Median - 2(Mean)

⇒ 46.36 = 2(Median) - 2(Mean)

⇒ 46.36 = 2(Median - Mean)

⇒ Median - Mean = 46.36 ÷ 2

⇒ Median - Mean = 23.18

**∴ The median of the data exceeds its mean by 23.18.**
